results.name: Mounting/folding does no IO; one open loads once despite repeated toggles
A detached reader ignores late fulfillment and cannot receive focus
Close during load does not build a hidden document; reopen still performs first positioning
Closing after render but before animation frame still positions on reopening
Manual directory positioning uses body-relative coordinates and moves keyboard focus
Automatic passage positioning never steals focus from another control
Length/hash corruption is rejected and the same entry can retry verified bytes
Two readers share one source fetch whose bytes pass integrity validation
Only exact source SHA, source ID and reading identity receive an inline reader
All complete saved documents render text literally, with every chapter and reading anchor
A failed open exposes a working Retry action
Truncated source payloads fail before parsing and can be retried
Closing the surrounding reading guide defers rendering and preserves initial passage navigation
New versioned documents load from their own collection with byte and source checks

scope: Shipped module + deterministic DOM geometry/transport; no browser layout or computed-style claim.
